```{r}
#PTEN 1 and 3 month analysis 

tableS22180 = read_excel(path = "~/Desktop/These/PTEN:VDR/22180/PTEN1 PTEN3/F22180_PTEN1 PTEN3.xls")
metadata <- data.frame(id=colnames(tableS22180)[2:7], cond=c(rep('PTEN_1m',3), rep('PTEN_3m', 3)))
rownames(tableS22180) = tableS22180$`Ensembl Gene ID`
count<-tableS22180[,1:7] 
metadata <- subset(metadata, id %in% colnames(count))
rowname<- count$`Ensembl Gene ID`
count <- count[,-1]
rownames(count) = rowname
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=count,colData=metadata,design=~cond)


dds <- DESeq(dds, minReplicatesForReplace=Inf)

res.P1.P3 <- results(dds,  alpha=0.05, cooksCutoff=T, independentFiltering=T, contrast=c("cond","PTEN_1m","PTEN_3m"))


vsdata <- vst(dds, blind=T)
vsdata <- rlog(dds, blind=T)
x <- plotPCA(vsdata, intgroup=c("cond", "id"))
pcaData <- plotPCA(vsdata, intgroup=c("cond", "id"), returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))
ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, color=cond, label = id)) + geom_point() + geom_text() 

res.P1.P3$Gene_name <- rownames(res.P1.P3)
x = as.data.frame(res.P1.P3)
write_tsv(x = as.data.frame(res.P1.P3), file = "res.P1.P3.tsv")

```

```{r}
# Pathways
res.V1.P1 = read_tsv(file = "res.V1.P1.tsv")
test_up <- filter(res.V1.P1, (res.V1.P1$pvalue <0.05& abs(as.numeric(res.V1.P1$log2FoldChange))>0.3))
NCBI_id <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, test_up$Gene_name, 'ENTREZID', 'ENSEMBL')
test_up <- add_column(.data = test_up, NCBI=NCBI_id, .before  = 'Gene_name')
test_up <- test_up %>% distinct(NCBI, .keep_all = T)
# Create a vector of the FC 
test_up <- test_up %>% drop_na(NCBI)
file <- test_up$'log2FoldChange'
# Name vector with ENTREZ ids
names(file) <- test_up$NCBI

# sort the list in decreasing order (required for clusterProfiler)
file = sort(file, decreasing = TRUE)
file_h=file

nom = "res.V1.P1"


gse= gseKEGG(
  geneList = file_h,
  organism = "mmu",
  keyType = "kegg",
  exponent = 0,
 minGSSize = 10,
 maxGSSize = 500,
 eps = 0,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.1,
 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  by = "fgsea",
 nPermSimple = 10000) 

gse <- setReadable(gse, org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
if (dim(gse)[1]!=0) {
gse@result$Path='KEGG'
gse@result$orig=nom  
}
name <- paste0(nom, "_KEGG.csv")
gse3=gse
write.csv(gse@result,  file=name, row.names=T) 

gse=gseDO(
  geneList=file_h,
  exponent = 1,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  verbose = TRUE,
  seed = FALSE,
  by = "fgsea",
  nPermSimple = 10000,
  eps=0
)

gse <- setReadable(gse, org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
if (dim(gse)[1]!=0) {
gse@result$Path='DO'
gse@result$orig=nom
}
name <- paste0(nom, "_DO.csv")
gse4=gse
write.csv(gse@result,  file=name, row.names=T) 

gse=gseDGN(
  geneList=file_h,
  exponent = 1,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  verbose = TRUE,
  seed = FALSE,
  by = "fgsea",
  nPermSimple = 10000,
  eps=0
)


gse <- setReadable(gse, org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
if (dim(gse)[1]!=0) {
gse@result$Path='DGN'
gse@result$orig=nom  
}
name <- paste0(nom, "_DGN.csv")
gse5=gse
write.csv(gse@result,  file=name, row.names=T) 

# m_t2g2 
#m_t2g2 = read_tsv(file = "m_t2g2.txt")

gse=GSEA(
  geneList=file,
  exponent = 1,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  eps = 0,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  TERM2GENE=m_t2g,
  TERM2NAME = NA,
  verbose = TRUE,
  seed = FALSE,
  by = "fgsea",
)

gse <- setReadable(gse, org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID")
if (dim(gse)[1]!=0) {
gse@result$Path='GSEA'
gse@result$orig=nom  
}
name <- paste0(nom, "_Hallmarck.csv")
gse6=gse
write.csv(gse@result,  file=name, row.names=T)

```

save_pheatmap_pdf <- function(x, filename, width=3, height=5) {
   stopifnot(!missing(x))
   stopifnot(!missing(filename))
   pdf(filename, width=width, height=height)
   grid::grid.newpage()
   grid::grid.draw(x$gtable)
   dev.off()
}
save_pheatmap_pdf(Hmapsave, "test.pdf")

names(x1) <- c( "common","P3.vs.V3","P1.vs.V1")


Heatmap<-data.frame()

for(i in 1:length(x1)) {
    transit <- HMap_table %>% subset(Gene %in% x1[[i]])
    if (dim(transit)[1] != 0) {
    transit$'id' <- names(x1[i])
    Heatmap<- bind_rows(Heatmap, transit)
    }
}

    transit$'id' <- names(x2[i])
    Heatmapx<- bind_rows(Heatmapx, transit)
    }
}
